items.title: 'AI communism', rogue models, and the why Kimi K3 spooked Wall Street
items.content_text:
A new enterprise benchmark found frontier AI models handled fewer than half of the agentic IT tasks they were given.

AI still has to earn trust under real workload, not just in a demo.

If the task touches operations, customers, or money, ask what proof you would need before trusting an agent to own it.

If more benchmark results look like this, founders will need to slow down before handing critical work to agents.

Read the full Phoenix signal on phoenixventurestudios.com.
